dct_description_sm: Location of various public recreational areas including those in educational facilities within City of Kingston. Recreational Areas are defined as; Sport Fields, Sport Courts, Ball Diamonds, Play Areas, Playgrounds. Attributes include name, material type, condition. General Presentation, General Analysis. This data is updated via Ortho Photos.
